system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Records verification/inspection result for the implemented DEDS project. For your information, my inspection_result is dummy_inspection_result_5690, my application_id is None.

function.name: deds_verify_project
function.description: Records verification/inspection result for the implemented DEDS project. Transitions project_status to 'verified' upon passing. Verification is MANDATORY before subsidy disbursement. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse subsidy. Fails if project is not 'completed', inspection finds defects, or assets are not operational.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
